official_source_url.value: https://burgerzaken.gov.sr/paspoorten — Suriname's Directoraat Burgerzaken (official civil registry authority) lists a passport photo as "niet verplicht" (not mandatory) for new, lost, damaged, and renewal passport applications, noting it is only specifically recommended in the case of a baby ("Pasfoto: niet verplicht, maar wel aan te raden in het geval van een baby"). No size, background, or head-height specification is published, consistent with photo submission not being a standard requirement for most adult applicants.
